analysis.hypothesis: Need to implement group_norm_forward and tanh_forward CUDA kernels in custom_ops.cu. GroupNorm with num_groups=3 and num_channels=3 means each group contains exactly one channel, so normalization is per-channel over spatial dimensions. Input is non-contiguous (shape [16,3,2048,512], stride [3145728,1048576,512,1]), so kernels must handle strides. We'll compute mean and variance per (batch, channel) using parallel reduction. Then apply affine and tanh elementwise with strides.
